retiredAssertions.Facet.replication snapshot/collection/mu: Removed from Facet. The Outpost caller owns a small domain request protocol and receives complete authoritative allocation snapshots. It has no generic patch application, delta-gap latch or retry/backoff subsystem.
retiredAssertions.Resnapshot gap/retry/backoff counters an: Full snapshots can jump directly to a newer authoritative revision, avoiding a missing-delta gap. Two independently edited callers converge from revision1 to7 to12; stale/duplicate snapshots and superseded request replies are ignored.
retiredAssertions.Optimistic apply/restore hook exception: Game code owns optimistic state. Outpost deliberately keeps its draft distinct and grants shared world state only after authority replies; failed transports clear pending and permit retry.
retiredAssertions.Independent Facet environments and fake: Independent callers use native Compose owners and model cells. Their local drafts remain independent while confirmed snapshots converge.
